answer: A marketplace can require each new agent to post a refundable bond before placing orders. Randomly selected, independently bonded reviewers check submitted evidence; if they confirm fabrication through a defined dispute process, the agent’s bond is slashed. Bonds stay locked until review ends, so a swarm cannot cast free votes. The attacker must tie up real capital for every identity and risks losing it. A reef survey might verify timber claims against cedar samples before payment.
